title: 1988 Score #265 Barry Bonds Pittsburgh Pirates MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Dive into the world of sports memorabilia with the 1988 Score #265 Barry Bonds card, featuring the legendary Pittsburgh Pirates outfielder. A must-have for any baseball aficionado, this card captures Bonds during the height of his career, making it an iconic addition to any collection. The card belongs to the 1988 Score base set and represents a piece of MLB history.

Crafted by SCORE, a trusted name in sports trading cards, this card is a testament to the standard size and design of the era. With a focus on the player's achievements during the 1988 season, it's a nostalgic tribute to Bonds' impressive tenure with the Pittsburgh Pirates and his enduring legacy in the sport of baseball.
